Hinged Lantern

A ribbon becomes a room.

← ANIMATION ATLAS

The construction

Ten rigid panels and nine shared vertical hinge edges. Closure curls a straight ribbon into a decagonal lantern, then returns it intact. Hinge cascade staggers the joint angles. Turn off Closure’s Cyclic toggle to inspect a pose.

Each panel is positioned by rigid rotations and translations along the chain. The first and last edges meet at full closure but are not an extra hinge. Decorative facets are fixed to their panel.

Inspired by the linkages and folding ideas in MIT 6.849. This is a 3D articulated strip, not a planar hinged dissection. Rigidity and hinge continuity are tested; sampled collision checks are not a general collision-free proof. Panels have zero thickness.
